name: Sprkls.exe
storyline:
Sometimes when the world leaves wounds, everyone wants to escape somewhere else. So what if you could shape your own digital dimension?

Welcome to Mirrors OS - a haunted realm on your desktop. It is filled with ghosts, skeletons, and other creatures of the night, who have no place in the real world and are searching for the meaning they never found in life.

Just like Rin - a troubled dropout girl in early twenties, finding her refuge here.
As is often the case with lost souls, she doesn't have an ambition to change the world or someone else's lives, but occasionally gets pulled into little adventures, whether she is ready for them or not.
Everything was following its own course, until one day a corrupting glitch started to destroy the usual order of things, and a mysterious girl from her dreams reached out for help...

Rin's world is now yours to explore.
summary: sprkls.exe is a cute, melancholic story-driven adventure that unfolds entirely on your desktop.
